svg.title: Index Translator browser components, sentences and sync
svg.desc: After a translation the page asks the server for sentence ends and, when the paragraph counts differ, for the paragraph matching. The sync state turns the answers into click-to-sync scrolling. Hovering a sentence marks it, and its counterpart in the other view once the alignment has answered, using sentence ends from the segment module. mark a sentence: public/app.ts → public/sentence-hover.ts → public/sentence-align.ts → Server API.
